result.topic_en: Equivalence classes of prime ideals in function fields attached to plane curves: powers of prime ideals equivalent to 1, examples for the conic and the nodal cubic, and theorems for a base curve of genus 1 (cubic curve).

Die $n$ te Potenz eines jeden

items.english: The n-th power of every prime ideal is equivalent to 1.

items.quote:
Jedes {+Quadrat eines+}

items.english: The square of every ideal is equivalent to a single prime ideal.

items.english: If λ is a given prime number, there are λ^2 inequivalent ideals whose λ-th power is equivalent to 1.

items.english: There are 2 prime ideals through whose powers and products, in the sense of equivalence, all prime ideals whatsoever can be obtained by approximation.
